text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp came to an end, and 
Seiun Sky was—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: *droop*...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally exhausted~... Let me rest for 
a bit~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Specifically, until the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —Sky-san.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, King. What's up, why the serious 
face~?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Seems like you worked hard during the 
training camp. ...What are you scheming?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Plotting" is a bit harsh~ Training camp 
is meant for working hard, right?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Even though I've been training 
together with Special Week-san..."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"She's gotten even stronger over this 
training camp. Much more so than during 
the Derby."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, if it's Spe-chan, she'll definitely 
turn all that hard work into strength~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...You don't seem flustered at all. Why 
are youâ

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No, how do you plan on overcoming that 
wall?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
No, no. Even if I were thinking about 
that, why on earth would I tell you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
King's running in the Kikuka Sho too, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...! You're right.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Well, if there's one thing I can say—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"If the overwhelming favorite everyone's 
watching gets overturned... wouldn't that 
be fun?~"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoa, you startled me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, big words. Let's see you try if you 
think you can!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, this King has gotten 
stronger as well.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose to Special Week, and I won't 
lose to you, either...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh King, you're as fiery as ever, huh~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Which only makes it all the more 
satisfying to break down, though♪

And so, our intense summer training camp 
with Seiun Sky came to an end.
